svg.title: The agentic-harness software factory
svg.desc: Work enters from people, Linear and the harness's own feedback. A supervised session or an autonomous run defines and builds it. Every task passes the same judge, review, verify and CI checks, and a person merges the pull request. People set the rules in user-only files. Dashed parts are proposed or outside the harness.

text.tspan: and tests that name the AC ids.

svg.text: Only a person writes Approved-by. The approved spec is frozen.
AUTONOMOUS RUNS · OPT-IN · ON DEMAND OR NIGHTLY

text.tspan: worker per step and a worktree
The same role agents and the
same hooks, in a task worktree

svg.text: Policy approves only low-risk docs and refactor specs.
Anything else is escalated to a person; the run moves on.

text.tspan: A fail goes to the debugger, then
A regression links to its PR

svg.text: WHAT FAILS BECOMES THE NEXT TASK
